task_instance: Refactor a small monolithic Terraform configuration (a VPC + two public subnets + an internet gateway, built with the builtin terraform_data resource type so no provider download is needed offline) into a reusable ./modules/vpc module: designed variables.tf/outputs.tf interface with a validation rule, wrote main.tf using for_each/count, wrote moved{} blocks to migrate the existing real state into the module addresses, wrote module README.md documentation, and wrote a .tftest.hcl unit test suite (one passing plan, one expected-failure validation test).
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_gr/hashicorp__agent-skills__refactor-module@offline-workstation . Built monolith/main.tf with 4 terraform_data resources (built-in provider, needs no registry download, so it works fully air-gapped). Ran `terraform init` (succeeded: 'terraform.io/builtin/terraform is built in to Terraform'), `terraform apply -auto-approve` to create real state (4 resources applied, verified with `terraform state list`). Refactored into refactored/modules/vpc/{main.tf,variables.tf,outputs.tf,README.md,tests/unit_test.tftest.hcl} following the skill's interface-design/encapsulation/for_each patterns, plus refactored/main.tf (root module call) and refactored/migration.tf (4 `moved` blocks mapping each old resource address to the new module address). Copied the monolith's terraform.tfstate into refactored/, ran `terraform init` there (module + builtin provider initialized, no network), then `terraform plan`: output showed '(moved from terraform_data.vpc)' etc. and 'Plan: 0 to add, 4 to change, 0 to destroy' -- i.e. all 4 resources were recognized as moved into the module with no destroy/recreate, only in-place attribute updates from the intentional input changes (name, tags). Ran `terraform fmt -check -recursive` (found and then fixed alignment issues), `terraform validate` on both monolith and refactored configs (both: 'Success! The configuration is valid.'). Ran `terraform test` inside refactored/modules/vpc: 'run "valid_plan"... pass', 'run "rejects_invalid_cidr"... pass', 'Success! 2 passed, 0 failed.' Also demonstrated the skill's analysis-phase commands (`terraform state list`, `terraform show -json | jq '.values.root_module.resources[]...'`) against the monolith. All steps ran with zero network access, using only the terraform binary already installed on the machine and its built-in provider (no `terraform init` provider downloads were needed or attempted).
